title: Fractured Conscience
brief: Original-IP crpg-narrative game (sub-genre: crpg-narrative). Capture the core mechanics and game-feel of "Disco Elysium" (critically acclaimed, 97%) — but with your OWN original name, theme, characters and art. Do NOT reference or reuse that title's IP. SIGNATURE MECHANIC for this genre: . MUST SHIP COMPLETE: a working menu (title + difficulty + how-to + settings via FFG.Shell), the page control bar (fullscreen/mute/pause), a clear win AND lose state, readable HUD, and polished feel — it must play start-to-finish with no manual fixes.

design_doc.title: Fractured Conscience
design_doc.core_loop: You are a war crimes investigator arriving at a contested border city three days after a ceasefire, tasked with reconstructing what happened during the final siege. Your fragmented psyche manifests as competing internal voicesâ€”The Prosecutor, The Empath, The Cynic, The Soldierâ€”each interpreting evidence differently. Move through isometric investigation nodes (crime scenes, cafes, checkpoints), click on interactable objects and NPCs to gather testimony and artifacts, then engage in branching dialogue where your internal voices argue for different interpretations. Each choice strengthens certain voices and weakens others, shaping your final report and determining which faction gains legitimacy in the post-war order. The core feel is: lonely wandering + uncomfortable conversations + piecing together unreliable narratives.

in_v1: Single district (4-5 investigation nodes: collapsed apartment, field hospital, town square, border checkpoint, militia headquarters)
4 internal voices (Prosecutor/Empath/Cynic/Soldier) with voice-specific dialogue trees
6-8 NPCs with conflicting testimonies (survivor, militia leader, medic, refugee, collaborator, peacekeeper)
12-15 key evidence items (shell casings, medical records, propaganda posters, love letters, burned documents)
Branching dialogue system with voice influence tracking (each choice shifts voice dominance 5-15%)
3 distinct endings based on dominant voice combination (tribunal/reconciliation/cover-up)
Minimal pixel-art isometric nodes with click-to-move navigation
Text-based dialogue UI with voice color-coding (Prosecutor=red, Empath=blue, Cynic=gray, Soldier=olive)
Evidence journal that updates with contradictions highlighted
Background ambient audio (distant sirens, wind, murmured prayers)
Title screen, difficulty (affects how forgiving contradictions are), how-to-play, settings (volume/fullscreen), page controls (fullscreen/mute/pause)
Clear win (submit report with 60%+ coherence score) and lose (submit incoherent report, forced resignation cutscene) states
explicitly_out_v1: Character stats/leveling (voice influence is the only progression)
Time pressure or fail states during investigation (only final report matters)

art_direction.palette: Desaturated cold paletteâ€”slate grays, faded blues, rust browns, ash whites, with accent colors for internal voices (crimson/sapphire/charcoal/olive). UI uses parchment texture with typewriter font for evidence, clean sans-serif for dialogue.
art_direction.mood: Post-conflict exhaustion. Quiet devastation. Broken trust. The weight of choosing whose truth to believe. Visual references: Eastern European brutalist architecture, war-torn Grozny/Sarajevo photography, muted Disco Elysium UI, Papers Please oppressive bureaucracy. Sparse isometric scenes with strategic detail (a child's shoe, bullet holes, wilted flowers). Portraits are high-contrast ink sketches showing weariness and moral ambiguity.

milestone_plan.M1: Vertical slice: 1 investigation node (town square) fully playable with 2 NPCs, 3 evidence items, 4 internal voices arguing over a single contested event (civilian casualties). Dialogue system functional with voice influence tracking visible. Evidence journal displays contradictions. Proves core loop feels tense and morally uncomfortable.
milestone_plan.M2: Full mechanics pass: All 4-5 nodes navigable, click-to-move working, all dialogue trees branching correctly, evidence cross-referencing system complete (clicking evidence during dialogue triggers voice reactions). Implement coherence score algorithm (measures internal consistency of player's choices). Add title screen, difficulty select (Easy=forgive 2 contradictions, Hard=forgive 0), how-to-play, settings menu with volume/fullscreen.
milestone_plan.M3: Content complete: All 6-8 NPCs with full dialogue trees written and implemented, all 12-15 evidence items placed, all 3 endings scripted with unique final report text and aftermath cutscenes. Ensure at least 3 paths through investigation that lead to different dominant voice outcomes. Add page controls (fullscreen toggle, mute, pause).
milestone_plan.M4: Polish pass: Ambient audio for each node (wind, distant voices, creaking wood), UI transitions smooth (fade in/out between nodes, dialogue text crawl), evidence journal has ink-stain aesthetic, voice-colored dialogue highlights pop, tutorial tooltips on first investigation, save/load system working, readable HUD with voice influence bars always visible, final report UI formatted like official UN document.
milestone_plan.M5: Ship-ready: Implement win state (coherence â‰¥60% triggers 'Report Accepted' ending cutscene) and lose state (coherence <60% triggers 'Forced Resignation' cutscene with newspaper headline). Playtest start-to-finish 3 times for softlocks, typos, broken branches. Add credits screen. Ensure FFG.Shell integration complete (title/difficulty/how-to/settings). Final QA pass: every node loads, every dialogue option advances state, every ending reachable, no manual fixes required.

definition_of_done: Player can click 'New Game', select difficulty, read how-to-play, reach title screen, and start investigationâ€”all via FFG.Shell menus
Player can navigate all 4-5 investigation nodes via click-to-move
Player can examine all 12-15 evidence items and question all 6-8 NPCs with branching dialogue
Internal voices visibly react to player choices with color-coded text and influence bars shift in real-time
Evidence journal updates dynamically and highlights contradictions when cross-referenced during dialogue
Coherence score calculates correctly based on internal consistency of choices across all nodes
Player can reach all 3 distinct endings (tribunal/reconciliation/cover-up) based on voice dominance
Win state triggers (coherence â‰¥60%) with 'Report Accepted' cutscene showing geopolitical aftermath
Lose state triggers (coherence <60%) with 'Forced Resignation' cutscene and newspaper headline mockup
Page controls (fullscreen/mute/pause) work on every screen
HUD always displays: current node name, voice influence bars, evidence count, coherence score
Settings menu (volume slider, fullscreen toggle) persists preferences across sessions
Full playthrough (investigate all nodes, submit report, see ending) takes 45-75 minutes with no softlocks or broken branches
All text is typo-free and dialogue choices never lead to dead-ends or missing responses
Game runs start-to-finish on target platform with no manual code intervention required
